title: Open-support cube before changing output compactifications
statement: Use E and B of [def-asd-open-support-compactification-model]. Let sq=(g',f',f,g), sqU=(a,p,f,j), sqj=(c,j',j,g), sq'=(b,p',p,c), sqV=(a',p',f',j'), sqA=(b,a',a,g') be cartesian squares of schemes, with a,j,a',j' open immersions. For supplied cf of f and cp of p, the vertical pasting B(sq',cp).inv followed by open exchange for sqj, whiskered on the left by E(sqU,cf,cp).hom, equals the pasting of open exchange for sqA followed by B(sq,cf).inv, whiskered on the right by E(sqV,cf.ofIsPullback(sq),cp.ofIsPullback(sq')).hom. The output models are literal base changes: no chosen output compactifications or common-refinement comparisons enter, and no quasi-compactness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Coherences (i) and (iii): restriction of the compactification diagram to an open and adjunction transposition.

proof.text: Factor each supplied support comparison as its graph comparison followed by the graph-free tail. Construct the map between the two iterated pullback ambients by the pullback universal property. Pullback pasting and cancellation show that its proper and open factor squares are Cartesian.

Apply Cartesian exchange of the graph comparison for cp and cf.ofIsPullback(sqU), and the graph-free tail cube for cf. Naturality of open exchange moves the graph factor to the left. Paste the two equalities, then cancel the invertible compact-support exchanges to obtain the original equation.

proof_origin.place: Coherence (i): compare the proper/open diagram with its base change; the open factors are handled by the adjunction transposition in coherence (iii).

lean.statement:
theorem openSupportBaseChanged_cube
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X Y X' Y' U V U' V' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    {j : U ⟶ Y} [IsOpenImmersion j] {a : V ⟶ X} [IsOpenImmersion a]
    {p : V ⟶ U} (sqU : IsPullback a p f j)
    {c : U' ⟶ U} {j' : U' ⟶ Y'} [IsOpenImmersion j']
    (sqj : IsPullback c j' j g)
    {b : V' ⟶ V} {p' : V' ⟶ U'} (sq' : IsPullback b p' p c)
    {a' : V' ⟶ X'} [IsOpenImmersion a'] (sqV : IsPullback a' p' f' j')
    (sqA : IsPullback b a' a g') (cf : Compactification f) (cp : Compactification p) :
    (TwoSquare.vComp
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (compactificationSupportBaseChangeIso Λ sq' cp).inv)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sqj).hom)
      ).whiskerLeft (openSupportCompactificationIso Λ sqU cf cp).hom =
    (TwoSquare.vComp
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sqA).hom)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (compactificationSupportBaseChangeIso Λ sq cf).inv)
      ).whiskerRight
        (openSupportCompactificationIso Λ sqV
          (cf.ofIsPullback sq) (cp.ofIsPullback sq')).hom
